description: Operational evidence and promotion rules for licensed macro-release shadow capture windows.

timing_rules.trace_order: Append order must be non-decreasing in both observed_at and received_monotonic_ns.
timing_rules.clock_evidence: At least three independent clock samples must be recorded inside the registered pre-release window.
timing_rules.pre_snapshot: A consensus snapshot must be locally received strictly before scheduled_at and within the configured maximum age.
timing_rules.simultaneous_components: Every expected component must be received at or after scheduled_at within the registered completion window.
timing_rules.stream_continuity: Heartbeat gaps and explicit disconnect-to-reconnect gaps must remain within their separate registered limits.
timing_rules.post_window: The stream may close only after stream_end_at and a passing raw-store audit.

schedule_rules.versioned_source: Persist exact schedule bytes, SHA-256 and local receipt time for each run.
schedule_rules.freshness: schedule_captured_at must precede scheduled_at and meet the registered maximum age.
schedule_rules.drift: A trace whose schedule hash differs from its plan fails closed and requires a new plan rather than an in-place edit.
schedule_rules.timezone: Convert official source timezone with a named zone; do not hard-code a fixed Eastern-to-UTC offset.

promotion_rules.empirical_only: Synthetic drills, documentation examples and historical replays never count toward campaign promotion.
promotion_rules.complete_windows: Only windows passing every critical operational gate count.
promotion_rules.family_floor: Meet the registered complete-window minimum separately for CPI and NFP.
promotion_rules.economic_claim: Operational promotion never establishes predictive edge or authorizes live trading.
